For any inputs, C's public getters always report the initialized Semver version "1.0.0" and all eight L1 block values stay at their default (zero/zero-hash) values, since setL1BlockValues can never succeed.
setL1BlockValues always reverts when called by the test contract (not the fixed depositor), and number keeps its pre-call value.
Because depositorAccount defaults to the zero address on a fresh deployment, setL1BlockValues always reverts regardless of arguments, and all block-value getters keep their pre-call values.
